content.summary: TransCode Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:RNAZ) announced further progress on Thursday in its Phase 1a clinical trial of TTX-MC138 in patients with metastatic cancer. To date, 13 patients have received at least one dose of TTX-MC138 at four separate dose levels ranging from 0.8 mg/kg to 4.8 mg/kg. Two patients have been treated in the expanded enrollment.
